rq-pr-02.front: Average farthest distance hunters got from a road (Pennsylvania)?
rq-pr-02.diagram:

The average farthest point hunters reached from a road was 0.84 kilometres. rq-pr-03.front: Each 1 km closer to a road: how many more hunters?
rq-pr-03.back: About 3 times more likely to be hunted (90%).

rq-pr-04.front: Each 10 degrees flatter: how many more hunters?

rq-pr-05.front: What do hunted white tailed deer do with their movement?
rq-pr-05.back: Move less and use smaller areas more intensively (65%).
rq-pr-05.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320" role="img" aria-label="Four cards. Hunted deer move less and use smaller areas. They go to thick security cover away from roads. They shift movement toward night. They stay farther from open roads than closed roads.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="320" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200.0" y="26" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">What hunted deer do</text>
<rect x="10" y="40" width="186" height="128" rx="10" fill="#f5f1e4" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<g transform="translate(40 74) scale(0.8)"><ellipse rx="20" ry="8" fill="#8b5a2b"/><circle cx="17" cy="-8" r="6" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M19 -15 l-5 -10 m3 5 l-6 -2 M23 -15 l5 -10 m-3 5 l6 -2" stroke="#5c3b1c" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></g>
<text x="70" y="70" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Move less</text>
<text x="20" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">Smaller areas, used</text>
<text x="20" y="131" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">harder (65%).</text>
<rect x="204" y="40" width="186" height="128" rx="10" fill="#f5f1e4" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<g><polygon points="222.1,88 234,54 245.9,88" fill="#2f3a2b"/><rect x="232" y="88" width="4" height="6.800000000000001" fill="#6b4f35"/></g><g><polygon points="238.2,90 248,62 257.8,90" fill="#2f3a2b"/><rect x="246" y="90" width="4" height="5.6000000000000005" fill="#6b4f35"/></g>
<text x="264" y="70" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Go thick</text>
<text x="214" y="114" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">Security cover, away</text>
<text x="214" y="131" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">from roads (85%).</text>
<rect x="10" y="176" width="186" height="128" rx="10" fill="#f5f1e4" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<g><circle cx="40" cy="210" r="14" fill="#2f3a2b" stroke="#23261f" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M40 196 A 14 14 0 0 1 40 224 Z" fill="#f4e7b8"/></g>
<text x="70" y="206" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Shift to night</text>
<text x="20" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">Less daylight movement</text>
<text x="20" y="267" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">(65%).</text>
<rect x="204" y="176" width="186" height="128" rx="10" fill="#f5f1e4" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<g transform="translate(234 216) scale(0.9)"><rect x="-22" y="-14" width="28" height="14" fill="#2f3a2b"/><path d="M6 -14 h10 l8 8 v6 h-18 Z" fill="#2f3a2b"/><circle cx="-12" cy="2" r="5" fill="#23261f"/><circle cx="14" cy="2" r="5" fill="#23261f"/></g>
<text x="264" y="206" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Avoid open</text>
<text x="264" y="224" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">roads</text>
<text x="214" y="250" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">Closer to closed roads</text>
<text x="214" y="267" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="start">(70%).</text>
</svg>

rq-pr-06.front: Wyoming mule deer bucks in rifle season?
rq-pr-06.back: They chose security habitat away from motorized routes (85%).
